title: The rainy match
text:
On Saturday, Fajar put on his football boots. It was the day of the big match! He looked out of the window. Dark clouds filled the sky. Then the rain began, and it did not stop.

'The match is off,' said Mum. 'The field is too wet.'

Fajar sat on the sofa with his arms folded. He did not want to talk to anyone.

His little brother, Dimas, came in with a shoebox. 'Let's make our own football pitch,' he said. They used the box, some paper and a marble for the ball. They made two goals out of straws.

By lunchtime, Fajar was laughing. 'This is the best match ever,' he said.

In the afternoon, the sun came out, and a rainbow appeared over the field.
